sentences.text: The National Agricultural Science and Technology Management System (NASS) is a government initiative aimed at enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability.
The objective of NASS is to promote the use of science and technology in agriculture.
The scheme provides support for research and development in agricultural practices.
It aims to improve the livelihoods of farmers through better agricultural practices and technologies.
Eligibility criteria are not specified in the available sources.
The application process is not detailed in the available sources.
The timeline for implementation and frequency of assistance is not specified in the available sources.
The scheme is implemented by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) and its affiliated institutions.
NASS also focuses on capacity building and training for farmers and agricultural professionals.
It encourages collaboration between various stakeholders in the agricultural sector.
